head: 10 new music apps climbing the App Store this week
dek: These music apps came out in the last 60 days and rose into the US App Store's Music charts this week, from chord and synth instruments to metronomes and retro music players for your Apple Music library.
where: iPhone and iPad, US App Store paid Music chart this week
means: If you play an instrument or want a new way to listen to your library, these are small paid apps musicians in the US are buying right now.
todo: Check each App Store page first: Pretend Piano needs an Apple Watch, and Pocket Classic and Club Cassette need an Apple Music subscription to stream from Apple Music's catalog.

list.name: Chord Lab: Chord Synth
list.what: A chord instrument for iPhone and iPad with seven keys, a joystick and 110 sounds.

list.name: Pretend Piano: Air Instruments
list.what: Plays guitar, violin or piano on your Apple Watch from wrist movements and taps.

list.name: GigClick: Metronome, Setlist
list.what: A metronome built by a drummer, with custom meters and setlists for playing live.

list.name: Sandbender
list.what: An FM synthesizer with four operators, a wavefolder and drag-and-drop modulation.

list.name: Metronome by Audomi
list.what: A metronome from 10 to 400 beats per minute with a tempo ladder for practice.

list.name: Pocket Classic
list.what: Browses your Apple Music library with a click wheel, in the style of a classic music player.

list.name: Fold Accordion
list.what: An accordion on your iPhone; on iPhone Duo, opening and closing the phone works the bellows.

list.name: iSyn Tron: Synth & Beat Maker
list.what: A rebuilt version of the 2009 groovebox iSyn, with two synths and an eight-track drum machine.

list.name: RUN4 - Tape & Texture Machine
list.what: A four-track tape and texture machine that turns recorded sound into loops and playable instruments.

list.name: Club Cassette
list.what: Plays your Apple Music library or your own audio files on a virtual cassette player.
